checks: Different fields on the same thought merge without replacing either edit.
Same-field conflicts display both versions and survive reload without overwriting canonical state.
Keep mine resolves only the reviewed field and saves the retained human draft.
A newer revision during resolution requires review again; Use saved cannot apply an unseen version.
A delayed conflict-resolution read cannot roll the canvas back after a newer poll update.
Changed placement is acknowledged explicitly while retaining notes and the new parent.
A removed thought stays recoverable as a draft download and after reload; it is never silently recreated.
